name: Florianópolis
tagline: Brazil's Island of Beaches and Quality of Life
description: Florianópolis — "Floripa" — is a safe, scenic island-city in Santa Catarina with 42 beaches, a high quality of life, and a fast-growing digital-nomad and expat scene. It is markedly more affordable and safer than São Paulo or Rio, and Brazil's low-threshold residency options make it one of Latin America's most accessible coastal bases.

quickFacts.visa: VITEM XIV digital-nomad/retirement visa requires proof of ~US$1,500/mo foreign income or ~US$18,000 in savings — one of the G-20's lowest thresholds (valid 1 year, renewable); a separate retirement residency also exists; US/Canada/Australia citizens now need an e-Visa to enter
quickFacts.internetSpeed: Fiber available in the city with good speeds
quickFacts.safetyRating: One of Brazil's safest capitals; standard urban precautions apply
quickFacts.climate: Humid subtropical — warm summers and mild winters

housing.description: Furnished 1BR on a central walking street

dining.description: Home cooking with cheap local produce and seafood, plus casual meals out

entertainment.description: The island's 42 beaches (free), trails, and surf

1M.lifestyle: A furnished 1BR in central Floripa, home cooking built around cheap local produce and seafood, bus transit, and basic private care. The beaches are free — a lean budget still buys an enviable island lifestyle.

housing.description: Nicer 1BR in the center or near Lagoa da Conceição

entertainment.description: Lagoa nightlife, beaches, and an active surf/outdoor lifestyle

2M.lifestyle: A nicer flat near Lagoa nightlife or the beaches, dining out regularly, a private health plan, and an active surf-and-outdoor lifestyle. The comfortable middle of island living.

entertainment.description: Weekend travel, beach clubs, and water sports

3M.lifestyle: A beachside 2BR, a car for exploring the island, frequent dining, comprehensive private care, and weekend travel. The FIRE sweet spot for a beach-centric Brazilian life.

housing.description: Luxury condo in upscale Jurerê Internacional

luxuryExtras.description: Boating, beach clubs, and premium experiences

5M.lifestyle: A condo in upscale Jurerê Internacional, near-daily dining, a housekeeper, and a beach-club lifestyle. Upscale island living in Brazil's most fashionable beach enclave.

dining.description: Private-chef dining and the finest restaurants

entertainment.description: Boats, elite beach clubs, and a full social scene

10M.lifestyle: A beachfront house in Brazil's "Brazilian St-Tropez," full domestic staff, a private chef, boats, and an elite beach-club social scene. Fat-FIRE on the island, with the Atlantic at the doorstep.
